requirements.description: The user prefers energy class C or better, so the energy class must be C or any higher class (A1-A4, B, C).

The user wants the building located near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71), the site should score at or above this level for transit access.

A university student residence is inherently tied to nearby universities and schools, so education access is necessary for this project type. Per the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75), the site should score at or above this level.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so surface_area is filtered with a >= threshold.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 850 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C') AND mobility >= 71 AND education >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters offices (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili'), surface_area >= 850 sqm, within 3.0 km of the given coordinates, energy class A1-A4/B/C, mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by haversine distance to the reference point. Capacity of 60 people is not a requirement column, so it is not filtered.
